rule: Every error is fixed AND gets an antidote: an automatic check or test that fails if the same error comes back. One line here per error, in the same PR as the fix. test_errors_register.py fails any line whose antidote does not exist.

errors.error: Three pilots (006, 007, 008) given the same Short slot by the direction's task cards
errors.fix: PR #122: one slot per pilot (night of day D at D 14:00 UTC, morning at D 20:00 UTC)

errors.error: A Short that missed its slot rolled onto another pilot's slot
errors.fix: PR #123: pending_shorts skips slots used in the ledger or reserved by another pilot

errors.error: Reused image records missing from a new pilot (task card gap): render queue would skip it
errors.fix: PR #116: hydrate_reused.py is part of every script delivery

errors.error: Nothing stopped a Dot delivery from changing files outside its task card
errors.fix: PR #124: ALLOWED PATHS block in every card, checked on every Dot PR

errors.error: Offline tests existed that PR checks did not run
errors.fix: PR #123 and this PR: every test of the active folders runs on every PR

errors.error: Old plans contradicted the current rules (one told sessions to write APPROVAL.json by hand)
errors.fix: PR #121: superseded documents deleted; OPERATIONS.md lists the only directing documents

errors.error: Fallback reviewer models scored the same video very differently and could approve
errors.fix: Only the designated reviewer (gemini-3.8-flash) can PASS; others are UNKNOWN

errors.error: GitHub dropped the daily crons; tasks did not run
errors.fix: heartbeat.yml decides from the real run history and catches up

errors.error: Mining spent the Gemini quota the production review needed
errors.fix: Minings wait while production has work

errors.error: Runner render dispatched twice for the same work
errors.fix: runner-wake: active-run guard, cooldown, per-hash attempt bound (PR #106)

errors.error: pilot-004 QA FAIL: the same background repeated after a split hold
errors.fix: Hold images assigned once over the final holds

errors.error: pilot-003: the Scripture reference stayed on screen after the closing words
Miner rows (unproven instrument) blocked a good render
errors.fix: Miner rows are informative until proven on the holdout

errors.error: pilot-003 script (15.3 min, phrases shared with pilot-002) was written before any script acceptance existed
errors.fix: script_check.py runs on every pilot a PR touches, before images

errors.error: Nothing alerted when the queue of scripts ran short of the coming publication slots (engine could stop unnoticed)
errors.fix: Scripts kept 4 days ahead; daily report lists every slot of the next 4 days with its stage

errors.error: The final gate checked preflight against the scheduled time: an approval finishing < 15 min before the slot (or after it) would FAIL and the video would never publish, although publish.yml publishes a late approval at once
errors.fix: prepublish_gate checks preflight against preflight.effective_publish_at (the time publish.yml really uses); past Short slots are rolled forward, not a FAIL

errors.error: Dot cards #119/#120 had deadlines later than publish_at - 72 h, so the content runway would alert before the card was even due
errors.fix: Cards rewritten with deadline = publish_at - 72 h at the latest; card_check.py lints every script card before sending and on every Dot PR
